# shopify_shop (Data Source)

Reads the shop the provider is configured for.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "shopify_shop" "this" {}

output "currency" {
  value = data.shopify_shop.this.currency_code
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `currency_code` (String) Base currency.
- `enabled_presentment_currencies` (List of String) Currencies customers can pay in.
- `id` (String) Shop GID.
- `myshopify_domain` (String) The `*.myshopify.com` domain.
- `name` (String) Shop name.
- `plan_name` (String) Public display name of the Shopify plan.
- `primary_domain` (String) Host of the primary domain.
- `timezone` (String) IANA time zone.
